A patient run ahead, some practical advice
The subject is pet comfort

Travelers must verify their pet's travel plan with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before arrival so we can keep animals calm, handled safely, and matched to the right service path.

Comfort checks are under constant review. Our ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and care plans are adjusted for species, temperament, and visible signs of stress. Please keep carriers secure, clean, and well ventilated, and remove loose items that may shift in transit. Feed and water your animal only as directed by the desk, and avoid adding unfamiliar bedding at the last moment.

If your pet is nervous, let staff know at once. Brief notes on behavior, medical needs, and handling preferences help us protect the animal and reduce delay for the flight team. Travelers with companion animals should remain alert for staff guidance and follow all spoken instructions without hesitation.

For immediate support, go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
